name: Wings
tagline: Real-time credit and spending guidance based on current cash flow, for people without credit history.
problem: Traditional credit excludes newcomers and young earners with thin histories.
solution: Aggregates transactions and bank statements into a dynamic credit model that adjusts limits and guides spending, via messaging.
demo_moment: Team-described: see your credit capacity change as cash flow changes.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Exploring Hybrid Intelligence by Photon” among 195 submissions.

lessons: Inclusive credit pitches need a named excluded group.
